"Long-lived/Octane isolation","src/PermissionRegistrar.php, together with the package’s Octane listener wiring.","tests/Integration/OctaneListenerTest.php — specifically exercises separate sandbox applications and differing setPermissionsTeamId() values, guarding against context bleed between requests."
